title: Thread
description: Who said what, as a comment thread: quotes from the article, word for word, with replies for pushback. Fit for serious stories.

comments.description: In the order the article gives them, or the main voice first.

speaker.description: Who said it, named as the article names them. Never a made-up username.

role.description: Optional: why their words matter, shown as their flair, e.g. "Mayor of Vellmoor".

text.description: Copied exactly from the article, without the surrounding quotation marks. Mark a cut with "..." and an added word with [brackets].

reply.description: Optional: true when the article presents this quote as a response to, or pushback on, the one above. Indents it under that comment.
